info.title: emissario
info.description: Every address emissario answers: what to send and what comes back.

host.description: the host and port the server listens on

get.summary: Reports that the server is up

parameters.name: x-request-method
parameters.description:
the method of the request, set by the server and never by the client

Read by `backoffice-maintenance`, which runs in front of this route.

parameters.name: x-client-ip
parameters.description:
the ip of the connection, set by the server and never by the client

Read by `backoffice-client-ip`, which runs in front of this route.

parameters.name: x-forwarded-for
parameters.description:
the client chain a reverse proxy appended to, read only with --allow-x-forwarded-for

Read by `backoffice-client-ip`, which runs in front of this route.

200.description: It worked. The answer comes as `application/json`.
